text: Evening. Looking after my grandson tonight, he's 14 months. Temperature is 38 on the ear thermometer. I think he's got a sore throat, he's a bit fussy when he swallows, but he's drinking well enough. He won't settle to sleep, keeps popping back up, but otherwise he seems himself. One thing in case it comes up: there's a purple ring round his mouth, but that's the blackcurrant juice he had earlier. It wipes off with a wet cloth and his lips underneath are their usual pink. I suppose I just want to know if there's anything I should be doing for him overnight.
